_comment: Quiz behaviour knobs. The words themselves are built in backend/data/; this file is only how the quiz runs.
_comment-options: How many words a question offers, the answer among them. Memorise reads this too, because a gap offering words to pick from is the same question, so changing it here changes both tabs.
_comment-language: Which language a meaning is shown in. English unless the reader changes it, and changing it here changes what everyone sees first. Only the Qur'anic words have an Urdu meaning; the everyday list has no Urdu source, so an Urdu round says so rather than asking in English.
_comment-wrong: A wrong answer waits longer: the correction under it has to be readable before it goes.
_comment-insights: How many answers a category needs before its wrong-rate is worth showing. Below this, two wrong out of two reads as a weakness when it is only a small sample.
